detail.title: About Japanese Yu-Gi-Oh OCG cards
detail.body1: Yu-Gi-Oh has two distinct card games: the OCG (Official Card Game), printed in Japanese for the Japanese and Asian markets, and the TCG, printed in English and other languages for the West. OCG cards use different card numbers (e.g. JP set codes), can have different rarities and artwork, and follow a separate banlist and release schedule from the TCG.
detail.body2: Collectors and players buy OCG cards for exclusive prints, alternate art, and source pricing — including 25th Anniversary (クォーターセンチュリーシークレット) rarities and classic cards like Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Dark Magician, Red-Eyes Black Dragon, and modern staples like Ash Blossom. Because rarity and authenticity matter, we recommend reading the seller's condition notes and requesting photo inspection for high-value items. Kangaroo Japan is an independent proxy buying service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Konami.

customs.title: U.S. customs & taxes
customs.body: Importing trading cards into the United States is not automatically duty-free. We provide HS code guidance for trading cards, but U.S. customs duties and taxes are ultimately determined by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and the carrier. Any duties, taxes, or brokerage fees are the buyer's responsibility and are not included in our estimates.
